description:
This file defines a PHP class 'Sass' within the namespace 'Opencart orn
the Startup controllers of the Catalog module. It contains a method 'index' that compiles SCSS files to CSS using the ScssPhp compiler, and writes the resulting CSS files to the stylesheet directory.

classes.name: Sass
classes.description: Controller class responsible for compiling SCSS files to CSS during startup in the Catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Compiles all SCSS files in the view/stylesheet directory to CSS files if they do not already exist or if developer mode is enabled. Uses the ScssPhp compiler to process each SCSS file and write the corresponding CSS output.
